text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I thought today would be the day, and I
gave our
training sessions all I had...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Don't let your spirit break, either!

choice_data_list: Don't let your spirit break, either!
Don't let your spirit break, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah! Thank you so much! Hearing you say that gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I almost forgot. My dream's not just my
dream
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to snap out of this funk!
Let's keep
at it—starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You're totally right. If I give up now,
then I'm
really done for!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I love races, and I'll never let go of my
dream to
win! Today's the start of
working even harder for
first place!
